name: Avery Grey
source:
Avery is known for having a very messy apartment, but is dependable, just not with cleaning.

[spoiler]Avery's magic is trash magic. At one point they say it feels like trash is just drawn to them, and it actually is. They can manipulate discarded objects, being able to pull them together and pull them apart. Due to the vague nature of their magic, things left on the street like a discarded bicycle would also count as trash.[/spoiler]
